input: You are generating a PyLabRobot protocol for a 96-well plate. The experiment compares two enzyme conditions: Condition A (standard enzyme) and Condition B (engineered enzyme). Each condition has 24 wells. The remaining 48 wells are negative controls (no enzyme). Design a randomized well assignment with blocking by plate row: each row must contain exactly 2 wells of Condition A, 2 wells of Condition B, and 4 negative controls. The assignment must be reproducible with a fixed random seed of 42. Do not reveal the assignment yet; just state that you will generate it in the next step.
